name: The Sword Collector

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

hit.description: damage, or 6d8 + 44 damage if the Sword Collector scores a critical hit.

effect.description: The Sword Collector flies up to its speed and uses armblade twice at any point during this movement. It doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks when moving away from any target of one of these attacks.

powers.name: Twisting Slash
powers.trigger: An enemy within 7 squares of the Sword Collector hits it with an attack.

effect.description: The Sword Collector teleports up to 5 squares and uses armblade against the triggering enemy.

powers.name: Arcane Harmonics
powers.trigger: The Sword Collector starts its turn dazed, dominated, immobilized, restrained, stunned, or weakened.

effect.description: The Sword Collector ends the triggering condition and instead grants combat advantage until the start of its next turn.
